profile.title: Profile
profile.description: This is how people in your groups see you.
profile.invalid: Use 1 to 50 characters, without links or @.
profile.color-hint: Saved at once, in all your groups. Until you pick one, each group picks one for you.
profile.color-error: That didn't save. Try again in a moment.

address.title: Postal addresses
address.description: Only your Santa sees one, in a Secret Santa that sends gifts by post. Groups use your default unless you pick another there.

language.description: For this site and the emails we send you.
language.label: Language

passkeys.title: Passkeys
passkeys.description: Sign in with your fingerprint, face or device PIN instead of an email code.
passkeys.add-failed: Adding the passkey didn't work. Try again.

notifications.title: Email notifications
notifications.reminders: Reminders before deadlines and gift day
notifications.wishlistUpdates: When your giftee changes their wishlist or gets a tip
notifications.santaMessages: Psst! hints and questions from your Santa
notifications.nextYear: A yearly reminder to do it again (organizers)
notifications.joins: Who joined through the group link, once a day (organizers)

sessions.title: Signed-in devices
sessions.description: Lost a phone or used a shared computer? Sign out on every device, this one included.

export.title: Your data
export.description: Download everything Givto stores about you, as a JSON file.

delete.title: Delete account
delete.description: This removes your wishlist, your groups, tips and questions. Draws you're part of stay valid for the others, with your name replaced by “Deleted account”. If you organize a group, the person who joined it first after you takes over.
delete.dialog-description: This can't be undone. To be sure it's you, we'll email you a code.
delete.invalid-code: That code isn't right or has expired.

errors.rate-limited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
